newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's says founder recovering from surgery.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's says founder recovering from surgery.

text.p: Wendy's International Inc. founder and spokesman Dave Thomas, 64, was sitting up and talking Monday morning after quadruple bypass heart surgery, a spokesman for the fast-food restaurant chain said.
"His vital signs are very good," the spokesman said. "He has begun the recovery process."
Thomas, who underwent the operation Friday, founded Dublin, Ohio-based Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburger resturants, now a 4,800-store chain, in 1969.
He has not been involved in day-to-day operations for some time but has remained the company's folksy television advertising spokesman.
Wendy's said last week that Thomas had been admitted to a hospital with chest pains.
